Parent logistic-with-lag terms drive the initial |dN/dt|~76 signal (dozens of sigma), so all mechanisms are individually visible in the target output.</excitation_report>

rationale:
The upstream analyze_expression call confirms no derivatives, no integral kernels, no delayed/ungoverned functions: the RHS is a pure algebraic combination of N, crowding_load, and eight parameters. The typed ODE contract is inherited verbatim (state variables, state RHS, ICs). Sampling is a single time axis, t in [0, 15] with 300 linear points -- long enough to see the initial overshoot (N > K) drive the new resource-deficit mortality, the subsequent decline toward K, and the slow crowding_load relaxation. Parameter values were chosen in physically reasonable magnitudes: r=0.5, d0=0.1, K=80 (below the IC N=150 so the overshoot branch is immediately active, matching the scenario stipulation that trajectories can start above the ceiling), crowding_exponent=2 (standard theta-logistic), crowding_mortality_fraction=0.5 (equal split between recruitment suppression and mortality), crowding_relaxation_rate=1.0 (memory tracks N on a ~1-time-unit timescale), resource_deficit_mortality_rate=0.8 and resource_deficit_exponent=1.5 (both inside the evolution step's suggested ranges and tuned so the new term reaches 11.6*sigma on the target trajectory). Noise sigma=1.0 is small compared with |dN/dt|~O(10-80) in the transient and O(1-10) near equilibrium, giving a clean signal-to-noise for symbolic regression while still forcing every listed mechanism to make itself visible.</rationale>
